messages:
harper: PSA: our unofficial office mascot (the tiny ceramic owl on the snack shelf) just issued a new ordinance. :owl:

noah: is this about the toaster again? because the toaster has rights. :bread:

zuri: the ordinance was posted in the kitchen as a sticky note titled 'TOAST OWL DECLARATION'. it is very solemn.

harper: summary of key points (direct quote):
```
TOAST OWL DECLARATION v2
- All toasted items must be admired for at least 3 seconds before consumption.
- No bagels shall be left unattended next to keyboard-grade electronics.
- Anyone who burns toast must sing a 10-second sea shanty.
- The owl may be petitioned for snack mercy on Tuesdays.
```

katie: who wrote this? i'm picturing a deeply serious person with glitter pens.

zuri: it was anonymous. speculation: facilities intern + poetry major.

noah: question: does the 3-second admiration apply to gluten-free toast? inclusivity matters.

harper: yes. all toasts, all crusts. the owl is impartial.

ops-bot: Reminder: do not leave food where it can attract pests. Also: please do not tape sticky notes to the HVAC units. :robot_face:

katie: sticker-bot, can you add a 'Toast Owl' sticker to the lore cabinet? i want an onboarding slide.

sticker-bot: :sparkles: "Toast Owl" sticker added to #lore-cabinet. Congrats to the Owl! :sparkles:

zuri: propose we add a ceremonial toast (pun intended) to Friday retros. one crisp toast per sprint.

noah: annual tradition idea: 'Toast-off' where people compete for best toast styling. prize: owl's approval (tiny nod).

harper: rules: no actual fire hazards, judges are impartial, captions mandatory.

katie: if you win, you get to rename the owl for a week. i call dibs on 'Captain Crumb'.

ops-bot: Facilities note: please keep ceremony small and away from the kitchenette sink during business hours. Safety first. :robot_face:

harper: official log entry: "2124001111 - Toast Owl Declaration posted. Beginning of crispy era." :scroll:

zuri: closing: may your bread be golden and your meetings short. :sparkles:
